malicious.remediation: Remove {{package}} {{version}} from {{path}}, clear the package manager cache and regenerate the lockfile without it. Treat the machines and CI pipelines that installed it as compromised: rotate their tokens and keys (package registry, GitHub, cloud) and check whether they published anything in your name.
